discharged: For every source level and binary degree, the actual integral H1 class reduces to zero modulo a prime exactly when it is a prime multiple in integral H1. Coefficient lifting, kernel division and scalar regularity are proved for the literal homogeneous integral polynomial module. The existing native coefficient map extends linearly to the actual tensor product with any field of that prime characteristic and is injective. Finite prime-field coordinates and the exact reduction kernel prove injectivity. The same tensor map commutes with every full original Hecke correspondence. No kernel, lifting, coordinate, tensor injection or Hecke-compatibility assumption is supplied in these original-object consumers.
remaining: The nonzero tensor eigenclass with the prescribed integral H1 character and full original H1 Hecke commutativity still require proof.
